title: VPN Control
subtitle: Status and safe operations for the private Tailscale connection.

independence.title: Cloudflare and Tailscale are independent layers.
independence.description: This control does not change the firewall, public ports, routes, DNS, or exit node. Cloudflare remains responsible for published services; Tailscale maintains the private path between both endpoints.

degraded.title: Partial reading
degraded.description: Some telemetry could not be refreshed. Available data remains visible; refresh before running an action.

unavailable.title: VPN control unavailable
unavailable.description: The local Tailscale service could not be queried. Check the host bridge and try again.

nodeDetails.remoteRestartUnavailable: Remote restart requires the private peer to be reachable. Recover through the provider console; no public-IP fallback will be used.

disconnect.title: Disconnect VPN
disconnect.description: Disconnecting {{hostname}} will interrupt the private path until it is connected again.

restart.title: Restart Tailscale
restart.description: Restart the Tailscale service on {{hostname}}? Connectivity may fluctuate for a few seconds.

test.title: Test VPN connection
test.description: Run a private connectivity test between {{hostname}} and the remote peer?
